name: C2a knee medial bulge (bulb read) - reduce soft tissue, keep condyle core
C2b knee lateral bulge - reduce soft tissue
C2c distal thigh (vastus medialis / lateralis) - fill the supra-patellar waist so the thigh flows into the knee
C2d popliteal fossa - shallow the deep pit
C2e upper shank below the knee - continuous transition into the calf
C2f calf belly (posterior) - modest gastrocnemius form instead of a tube
